headline: Palace Orders Alternative Learning in NCR and 15 Provinces Amid Habagat and Haze
seoTitle: MC 134: Alternative Learning in NCR, 15 Provinces | FMB News
seoDescription: Memorandum Circular 134 ordered alternative learning modes in Metro Manila and 15 provinces because of continued Habagat rainfall and poor NCR air quality from haze.
deck: The directive covers public and private educational institutions and took effect immediately, while local executives retained authority over localized class suspensions.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Malacañang ordered all public and private educational institutions in Metro Manila and 15 provinces to implement alternative learning modes and learning-continuity measures on September 4.
The directive was contained in Memorandum Circular No. 134 signed by Executive Secretary Ralph Recto upon the recommendation of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council.

sections.heading: Areas covered
paragraphs: The order covers Metro Manila, Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, La Union, Pangasinan, Abra, Benguet, Zambales, Bataan, Bulacan, Tarlac, Pampanga, Cavite, Laguna, Batangas and Occidental Mindoro.

sections.heading: Why it was issued
paragraphs: The Palace cited anticipated continued heavy rainfall associated with the enhanced southwest monsoon and poor air quality in Metro Manila due to haze from severe forest and peatland fires in Kalimantan and Sumatra, Indonesia.

sections.heading: Local authority remains
paragraphs: Local chief executives may still order localized cancellation or suspension of classes under existing rules.
